consts.REBOOT_PREP: case "$(settings get secure always_on_vpn_app)" in com.tailscale.ipn) ;; *) pm path com.tailscale.ipn >/dev/null 2>&1 && ip addr | grep -qE 'inet 100\.(6[4-9]|[7-9][0-9]|1[01][0-9]|12[0-7])\.' && { settings put secure always_on_vpn_app com.tailscale.ipn; settings put secure always_on_vpn_lockdown 0; };; esac; echo ok
consts.TVSET_READ: echo sdk $(getprop ro.build.version.sdk); echo dns_mode $(settings get global private_dns_mode); echo dns_host $(settings get global private_dns_specifier); echo dns_off $(settings get global tvr_dns_off); echo sleep $(settings get secure sleep_timeout); echo saver $(settings get secure screensaver_enabled); echo saver_after $(settings get system screen_off_timeout); wm density; echo home $(cmd package resolve-activity --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME | tail -n 1); cmd package query-activities --brief -a android.intent.action.MAIN -c android.intent.category.HOME | grep / | sed 's/^ */launcher /'
consts.BOOT: cmd package query-receivers --brief -a android.intent.action.BOOT_COMPLETED 2>/dev/null | grep / | sed 's/^ *//'
consts.SETTINGS_READ: for n in global secure system; do settings list $n 2>/dev/null | sed "s/^/$n /"; done; for s in 1 3; do echo "vol $s $(cmd media_session volume --stream $s --get 2>/dev/null | grep 'volume is')"; done
